'''LodeCorp Mining''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] company that existed during the time when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was replaced by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. LodeCorp Mining had a mining operation on an [[Asteroid Nine-Alpha-Four|asteroid]] in the [[Roche system]].<ref name="IC 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>
